title: Netflix launches Tudum.com in Brazil with brand-new, local content for fans
summary: Brazil is the first country to have its own version of Tudum, with daily behind-the-scenes content, interviews, and first-hand news about films and series
body_markdown:
A true fan always wants more. With that in mind, Netflix launched


Tudum.com


, a platform featuring exclusive content about films, series, reality shows, and other Netflix favorites. The website is now expanding beyond English for the first time, and launching its


[Brazilian version](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/pt-br/artigos/sobre-tudum) with exclusive coverage for local audiences.


“Brazilian audiences are unique when it comes to passion and engagement. We see the strength of fandoms every day on social media, at fan events, in the theories they come up with, and in the affection with which they embrace our stories and characters,” says Jana Borges, Senior Marketing Director at Netflix Brazil. “Launching the Brazilian version of


[Tudum.com](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/pt-br) is one of our ways of giving back all that love, creating an official gathering place for those who want to explore all there is to know about their favorite films and shows.”


[Tudum.com](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/pt-br) offers first-hand behind-the-scenes access to titles, interviews with cast and creators, news about new productions, editorial team recommendations, Top 10 rankings of the most-watched films and shows, and more.


"We have so much gratitude for the enthusiasm our Brazilian fans bring to Netflix, which made the decision to launch


[Tudum.com](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/pt-br) in Brazil an obvious choice. We are thrilled to bring the stories behind the story directly to this valued audience”, says Krista Smith, Senior Publishing Director at Netflix. “Whether it’s a Stranger Things table read, deleted scenes from Rulers of Fortune, or exclusive news straight from Netflix, we are committed to enhancing the experience of your favorite shows and films and offering a destination to discover your next obsession.”


The platform is open to all, but Netflix members have an additional perk: if you log in with your Netflix account, the website will become a personalized hub, identifying your preferences and delivering special features, interviews, and lists tailored to your profile. Additionally, Tudum.com Brazil has also launched a


[WhatsApp channel](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbDodrK6mYPMINX7Sf1H) , an exclusive place where fans can get direct updates of the most exciting news.
